correctness.rationale: The second-difference rows are linearly independent; all active subsets have strictly complementary realizations with local orthogonal projector H_A. Translation equivariance and the step decomposition reduce the global path-BV norm exactly to finite face/jump maxima. A standard-library rational checker exhausts all 511 faces for n=2..10 and verifies finite KKT input-pair witnesses for all maxima. A separate explicit endpoint-free/interior-affine face yields the analytic even and odd lower bounds, whose limit inferior is at least two. No statement is made about an upper limit or n>=11 exact coefficients.

value.rationale: Convex least-squares regression is a natural shape-constrained estimator. Adjacent variation measures sensitivity to local signal jumps and is distinct from Euclidean stability, coordinate max-norm and Gini norms. The first amplification threshold n=4, complete exact n<=10 classification including a genuine n=8 to9 plateau, and an analytic near-doubling family are mathematically motivated non-implied stability facts, with finite attainment and reproducible certificates; no general theorem-sized contribution is needed.
